name: Nga Thongba
instructions: 1. Marinate the fish pieces with salt and turmeric, then shallow fry in mustard oil until golden; set aside.
2. In the same pan, heat more mustard oil and temper with bay leaves.
3. Sauté chopped onions until translucent, then add ginger-garlic paste and fry until aromatic.
4. Add turmeric and chili powder mixed with a little water to form a paste.
5. Stir in the mashed potatoes and cook for a few minutes to incorporate the spices.
6. Add water as needed to reach the desired consistency and bring to a boil.
7. Carefully slide the fried fish into the gravy and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
8. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice.
description: Nga Thongba is a classic Manipuri fish curry that holds a special place in the local cuisine. The use of mashed boiled potatoes as a thickening agent gives the curry a unique, silky texture that distinguishes it from other regional fish curries, reflecting the simple yet flavorful culinary heritage of Manipur.
